definitions.explanation: Suffix indicating a style, form, or manner of doing something.

examples.japanese: ⟦{筆記|ひっき}{体|たい}→筆記体：25771_hikkitai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
⟦{活字|かつじ}→活字：00202_katsuji⟧{体|たい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{手書|てが}き→手書き：08301_tegaki⟧{体|たい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧。
examples.english: Printed font and handwritten style are different.

examples.japanese: {敬|けい}{体|たい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{常|じょう}{体|たい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}い{分|わ}ける→使い分ける：07666_tsukaiwakeru⟧。
examples.english: Use polite and plain styles appropriately.

notes:
{体|たい} is a suffix indicating a style, form, or manner.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:

Writing/Font styles:
- ⟦{筆記|ひっき}{体|たい}→筆記体：25771_hikkitai⟧: cursive script
- ⟦{活字|かつじ}→活字：00202_katsuji⟧{体|たい}: printed font
- ⟦{明朝|みんちょう}{体|たい}→明朝体：22715_minchoutai⟧: Ming/Mincho typeface
- ⟦ゴシック{体|たい}→ゴシック体：26661_goshikkutai⟧: Gothic typeface

Grammatical styles:
- {敬|けい}{体|たい}: polite form (です/ます)
- {常|じょう}{体|たい}: plain form (dictionary form)

Other uses:
- ⟦{液|えき}{体|たい}→液体：04134_ekitai⟧: liquid (state of matter)
- ⟦{固|こ}{体|たい}→固体：14852_kotai⟧: solid
- ⟦{気|き}{体|たい}→気体：02632_kitai⟧: gas

USAGE:
{体|たい} as a suffix differs from ⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧ (body). When attached to other kanji, it typically indicates a style, form, or state.
